name: ThemeLensReviews
job: Show a set of reviews with theme chips (service, price, speed, quality); choosing a chip highlights the matching sentences across all reviews and fades the rest
visitor_action: tap a chip; tap again to clear; keyboard focus on chips (arrow keys move between chips)
mobile: chips scroll sideways, reviews stack single column
motion: highlight bands sweep across matched phrases, other text dims to 55 percent (reduced-motion: static highlight, no sweep)
art_direction: Highlighter peach: warm paper cards, peach-orange highlighter bands, charcoal serif text, subtle paper grain
